All of these systems were considered to be accurate, to have moderate desirable effects, small to trivial undesirable effects, with a balance of effects that probably favours their use in clinical practice and is likely to be acceptable to stakeholders. The overall level of certainty of the evidence for the different aspects of the judgments made about these systems varied between very low and low.
